name: Yousei
source:
Early 20th century, Western Europe. Protagonist has had success as a painter, but he feels a sense of emptiness in his life with each day repeating over and over. But one day a small winged fairy fitting his palm falls from the sky. He takes her home and finds a new source of inspiration in her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
20世纪初的西欧。主角作为画家已经取得了成功，但日复一日的生活让他内心空虚。一天，一只小得能放在掌心、长着翅膀的妖精从天而降。他将她带回家，也从她身上找到了新的创作灵感。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]）
